alternatives.transcript: Notes to give context to the files in this folder. Update edition for August 2020. Thomas Genu evidently located a complete set of the rbti Morieta tapes and put them on his website. I have modified the tape set for express size by removing the pauses and changing the quality from four four k to eight k. There are various benefits. First, the listening time is reduced approximately 30%. Using a music player with variable speed can further speed listening time. Further, this allows full listening ability, but reduces the footprint to a very low file size so they can be loaded onto a music player or mobile phone. This entire set of 58 tapes is only 325 megabytes instead of the four and a half gigabytes of the original. These 29 tapes, 58 audio files, are some of the more interesting I have heard. There are some important lessons to be learned from them. Here are a few examples. One. You will hear John Black making comments that only a true acid alkaline adherent would make. Doctor reams had little use for food combining and it is easy to imagine that issue becoming a major conflict between black and reams. We know that reams did not like the high stress foods label that black and certain others used. This is probably why reams once commented that the GMS reams diet booklet that black printed was essentially worthless. Who knows how many copies of the erroneous booklet were distributed as authentic or approved. It is hard to get a genie back in the bottle. Two. Toward the end you will hear doctor reams trying his best to get students to understand that cancer is a dead cell and therefore incapable of doing anything at all. This is a constant in his teaching, but so few students understand that cancer can do nothing no matter how much their imaginations lead them to believe that cancer multiplies, grows, or spreads. Reams patiently teaches over and over that when a body is given the minerals needed to build new cells and the water to wash out old dead cells, cancer and its residue goes away. Three. Reams and Rudd clearly loved one another and had great plans to to revolutionize American health, first then the world. As things turned out, the medical establishment had other plans and the power to simply crush any threat to their profits. Tragic. Four. There is a good bit in this series about iridology. A problem is that there is scant evidence to indicate reams bothered with the iris of the eye. However, he was all in on sclerology and personally taught it to others in his retreats. Five. Doctor. Beto and Bob Pike were fairly new in the rbti lineup in JuneJuly nineteen seventy seven, but reams clearly already trusted their rbti understanding and judgment. Please leave this file, but please add anything you know or can contribute. And please forward any tapes or audio files to Rex Herald to have added to the record. Brixmanusgmail dot com. October an edition by an anonymous reams student. Please be careful when reviewing tape 6a at approx 11:48, Johnston talks about the doctor patient handbook by Jensen and the healing crisis. I don't know how much contact doctor Jensen had with reams but in his books he does not defer to reams, although you can hear Jensen deliver a short lecture on one of the Moriarta tapes. I think I only saw one reference to reams in all my reading of Jensen's books. If the listener invests in that booklet, he should be alerted, or not, that there should be a good basis of reams understanding so that she or he won't get mixed up with Jensen's ideas that are contrary to reams. Note by RH, Jensen only worked from observation. He did not understand how to go by the numbers and therefore missed out on the superior analysis and care offered by rbti.
